intro.h2: A cabinet showroom you can walk through
paragraphs: DC Kitchen & Bath sells kitchen cabinets in Westbury from a showroom on Old Country Rd. You can walk through full kitchen displays, open the doors, compare finishes and talk through countertop options in person before you choose. The showroom is open six days a week.

Customers often come in with a bigger plan than one room. One homeowner renovating an entire house worked with Jay on her kitchen, three bathrooms and a master closet, then picked her countertops and knobs here too. Reviewers mention Jay's knowledge of kitchen and bath design, and Google shows kitchen cabinets as the topic people mention most.

about.text: DC Kitchen & Bath, listed on Facebook as DC Kitchen & BATH INC, is a kitchen and bathroom cabinet and countertop store in Westbury, New York. The showroom sits at 896 Old Country Rd, where customers walk through displayed kitchens before choosing their own. Jay is the name that comes up in reviews: the person customers work with on design and on their order, together with his team. Homeowners come in for a single kitchen or, like one customer, for cabinetry across an entire house renovation.
about.owner_role: Named in reviews as the person who handles design and orders; full name and title not published

steps.title: Visit the showroom
steps.text: Stop in at 896 Old Country Rd during opening hours, or call (516) 280-7988 first, and walk through the kitchen and bathroom displays.

steps.title: Talk through your design
steps.text: Bring your room sizes and ideas. Jay and the team help you think through layout, door style, finish and countertop choices.

steps.title: Choose cabinets, counters and hardware
steps.text: Pick everything in one place, from kitchen and bathroom cabinets to countertops and knobs, so the rooms match.

steps.title: Confirm your order
steps.text: Review the final selections, sizes and price with the team before the order is placed, and ask any questions about delivery.

items.name: Julia
items.text: I'm so happy with Jay's service! Recently, I renovated my entire house and was looking for cabinetry with great quality and reasonable prices. After looking at a few places, I found DC Kitchen & Bath. Jay is so knowledgeable about kitchen and bath design, and he and his team helped me with my kitchen, three bathrooms, master closet, and even the countertops and knobs. Everything turned out beautifully and I could not thank Jay and his staff enough!

service_area.h2: Visit us in Westbury, New York
service_area.text: DC Kitchen & Bath works from its showroom at 896 Old Country Rd, Westbury, NY 11590. Westbury is the town on its Google profile and on its Facebook page, which describes the business as kitchen and bathroom cabinets and countertops near Westbury. If you are planning a kitchen or bath project nearby, stop in during opening hours or call (516) 280-7988 to ask about your home.

items.q: Where is the showroom and when is it open?
items.a: The showroom is at 896 Old Country Rd, Westbury, NY 11590. Google lists the hours as Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 5:45 PM and Saturday from 9 AM to 5 PM. It is closed on Sunday. Call (516) 280-7988 if you want to check before you drive over.

Kitchen cabinets, bathroom cabinets, kitchen countertops and bathroom countertops, according to the store's Facebook page. Customers have also chosen knobs here and had a master closet done along with their kitchen and bathrooms. Ask in the showroom if you are looking for something for another room.

items.q: Can someone help me with the design?
items.a: Yes. A Google reviewer describes Jay as so knowledgeable about kitchen and bath design. Bring a sketch or measurements of your room, and photos of what you like, and the team can help you work through layout, cabinet style, finish and countertop choices before you place an order.

items.q: Can I do a whole house, not just the kitchen?
items.a: Yes. One Google reviewer renovating her entire house worked with Jay and his team on her kitchen, three bathrooms and master closet, and picked her countertops and knobs at the same time. Planning several rooms together helps keep cabinet styles and finishes consistent through the home.

items.q: How do I get a price for my cabinets?
items.a: Call (516) 280-7988 or email dckitchenb@gmail.com with your room measurements, or bring them to the showroom. Pricing depends on the cabinet line, the finish, the countertop material and how many rooms you are doing, so the team will price the selections you make.

final_cta.h2: Come see the cabinets in person
final_cta.text: Visit the showroom on Old Country Rd or call to talk about your kitchen or bath.
